info.title: API.SH: DEV Community
info.description: The DEV Community API from API.SH: public DEV Community data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One DEV article's details: title, summary, link, canonical link, dates (published, edited, crossposted, last comment), reading time, comment and reaction counts, tags, language, images, series id, AI disclosure, author and organization. The article text is returned only with include=body (`body_markdown` and `body_html`); include=reactions adds `reaction_counts`, the count per reaction type (like, unicorn, exploding_head, raised_hands, fire, readinglist).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/devto-article

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated extras: body (the full article as `body_markdown` and `body_html`), reactions (`reaction_counts` per reaction type).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Articles on DEV (dev.to) by tag, tags, author or organization, as the feed, latest, top of the last N days, fresh or rising: id, title, summary, link, canonical link, dates, reading time, comment and reaction counts, tags, language, cover image, author (name, username, Twitter and GitHub handles) and organization. Titles and summaries only, not the article text. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/devto-articles

parameters.name: top_days
parameters.description: With sort=top: the number of days (default 7).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
